description.text:
SWSH Chinese Promos holds the promos of the Simplified Chinese game's Sword & Shield years, numbered NNN/S-P. Certified gyms went on giving a pack with one random gym promo at their events, with a new wave as each Sword & Shield booster came out: 113 to 124 arrived with Nine Colours Gathering on 1 March 2024, and the next wave, from 145, with Brave Stars on 18 June 2024.

Battle Party's King's Battles went on too. Every player in the second season, 300 events from 16 September 2023, got Olivia (丽姿), and each champion a holo Olivia; the third and final season, from 9 March to 25 May 2024, gave its champions a holo Kahili and then a holo Mina, 150 of each. Olivia, Kahili and Mina carry the King's Battle mark, in both finishes. Players in the qualifiers of the 2023 Bilibili World Champion Road Cup, held in eight cities, got a Morpeko made with Bilibili World, 138/S-P. Our list numbers the cards 001 to 220.

tell.text: The Shenzhen Master Tournament emblem, with the city's name, stamped on the picture.

description.text: A copy with the Shenzhen Master Tournament logo, the commemorative card of the 2024 Shenzhen Master Tournament, held at the Shenzhen Convention and Exhibition Center on 21–22 December 2024. Buying one of a list of gift boxes at the tournament's shop came with one, 1,500 in all, and another 500 went the same way at its pop-up in Shenzhen Talent Park from 19 December 2024 to 1 January 2025.
